name: Petras Auštrevičius - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the EU enlargement strategy
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its view on how the EU should take in new member countries. It says joining must stay based on real reforms, especially the rule of law and democracy, with no shortcuts and no fast track. It asks the EU to keep supporting countries working to join, to prepare its own institutions and budget for a bigger union, and to stand firm against Russian and Chinese interference. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for faster, merit-based talks and EU reforms to prepare for growth.
- **Who it affects:** Countries seeking to join, current member states, and EU citizens.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, the Commission and national governments for their response.
